people.name: Saurabh Gupta
people.role: Director and Group Chief Financial Officer
people.bio: Mr. Saurabh Gupta has over 22+ years of experience in finance and strategy across manufacturing, cinema, real estate, and consulting. He is a Chartered Accountant, Company Secretary, MBA from MDI Gurgaon, and Harvard Business School alumnus.

people.name: Prithvi Vachani
people.bio: Prithvi Vachani is currently Vice President at Dixon Technologies. A Bentley University graduate with an MBA from London Business School, he has led strategic expansions, facility establishment, and key account management in mobile and IT hardware divisions.

people.name: Sunil Vachani
people.bio: Mr. Sunil Vachani has over three decades of experience in the EMS industry. He is the Promoter and associated with Dixon Technologies (India) Limited since its inception.

people.name: Josh Foulger
people.role: President- IT Hardware and New Projects
people.bio: A seasoned industry veteran with over 30 years of global experience in Electronics System Design & Manufacturing. Previously CEO of Electronics at Zetwerk, Managing Director of Bharat FIH, and held leadership roles at Nokia.
